svg.aria-label: Map of David Silver's motorbike route, c. summer 1951: Exeter along the south coast to Dover, Calais, Boulogne, Amiens, Paris, Bourges and Blois, returning by Chartres, Dreux, Evreux, Amiens and Boulogne.

g.text: on the road; found by police

svg.text: probably summer 1951, from his three letters home
Lines join the places he names, not the exact roads. Base map: Natural Earth.
